projects.title: My Projects
projects.carouselTitle: Here's a look at my most recent project — a school elections web application for Colombian institutions, featuring a real-time database and local network connectivity.

carousel.caption: Secure homepage that provides teacher-only access via password and identifies students by their ID.
Student voting interface displaying candidates' photos, names, and proposals for each position, with an option for blank votes.
Administrative panel for managing institution details, election settings, and credentials, with an archive of past elections.
Students management tab allowing admins to view, edit, delete and import student records via CSV.
Candidates tab for managing candidate profiles and position assignments.
Results dashboard presenting real-time vote tallies and exportable reports.
Confirmation screen informing students their vote was recorded, with automatic redirect to the homepage after a few seconds.
